cellSemantics.cellTypes: Original Excel type including default n; null means no cell element. Empty cell elements retain their source type.
cellSemantics.dates: Observation year_from/year_to only; no phase imputation, clipping, endpoint sorting, or year-zero rewrite.
cellSemantics.raw: All original headers exist. Numeric and boolean XML values remain strings; string payloads are resolved exactly. Null denotes no supplied payload.

evidenceLimits: The workbook has no per-record coding explanation or bibliography; no evidence associations are inferred.
identity: Row identity is source SHA-256 + exact worksheet name + Excel row number, not an API record identifier.

license.status: Not specified in the preserved pinned README. No Equinox license assertion is transferred to Polaris.

transformations: Parse all eight original worksheets and preserve raw fields and cell types.
Partition observations by exact original polity_id.
Keep CrisisDB rows separate by recordKind.
Retain all 626 polity records, including seven without observations.
Deterministic compact JSON and gzip mtime=0.
